text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 110 mm length of 12 mm bright bar; chamfer the ends 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: From the chain-side end: file 1 mm flats 0 to 12 mm (sprocket) and

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at each bearing (16 to 28 mm and 34 to 46 mm).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: File a D-flat 1.4 mm deep over the last 25 mm (85 to 110 mm): the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: collar set screw, the plate's hub and the plate sit on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 5.0 mm, 18 deep, in the plate end and tap M6, 15 deep, for

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the plate knob. Centre it in a vice V-block under a drill stand.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: held from the chain side only, in two bearings on the bearing

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: plate; its plate end stops level with the plate's door-side face.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a seed plate slides on and off the D-flat by hand.
